subject: bia
title: BIA.------EXT.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 92 (CS-20). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject; EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, TR (transformation) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INFO-DY: INFO-SO-D, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: AGT (agreement). From AGT: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TR: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From SOC-RT-DY: MULT-DEVF.
